{{Quote|Can you feel it? This place is a pot ready to boil over. Too many sentients, not enough resources&hellip; not enough hope.|K'Kruhk regaarding the refugee camp|<ref name="FireCarrier1" />}}
A '''refugee camp''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkinnea]] was founded<ref name="FireCarrier1" /> around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="FireCarrierDate" /> to harbor refugees displaced by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The camp was managed by the [[Arkinnea Militia]]&mdash;who had a distaste for the refugees due to the events of the war&mdash;under the supervision of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[K'Kruhk]] were assigned to [[section two-four-one]] of the camp.<ref name="FireCarrier1" /> The refugees from the camp, save for the Jedi thanks to the warnings of Jedi Master [[Zao]], were all killed by the Arkinnea Militia by way of being dropped from the hatch of an [[Ore carrier/Legends|ore carrier]].<ref name="FireCarrier3">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 3|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 3]]</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
